posts.name: SkoraPrep
posts.tagline: Daily, smarter SAT & ACT practice, 10 minutes at a time.
posts.description: SkoraPrep is a personalized SAT and ACT practice platform created and founded by a high school junior. Built for the way students study today, it delivers short, focused rounds of 10 to 20 questions that fit into the small moments of the day. Every answer shapes what comes next, adapting difficulty and directing practice toward the areas where each student can improve most.

posts.name: Apollo
posts.tagline: Every WordPress site. One calm desktop app.
posts.description: Apollo is a fast, native desktop app for managing every WordPress site you own or look after — create content, keep sites healthy and secure, grow traffic, and look after all your sites from one window. Your sites, your machine, your data.

posts.name: Shortshort
posts.tagline: One long video in. Up to 20 shorts, cut on full sentences.
posts.description: Drop a talk, podcast or course (MP4/MOV/WebM, up to 2 GB and 3 h). shortshort finds the moments worth watching, ends each on a complete sentence, reframes 9:16 on the speaker and captions every word. Up to 20 MP4s in 1080x1920. 60 free credits, no card.

posts.name: Syllbi
posts.tagline: Syllabi for everything
posts.description: Syllbi is a free iOS app for exploring an artist's catalog, a franchise, or a genre as a branching guide instead of a flat list: start at one entry point and follow whichever connection matches what you actually want next. It already ships with guides across books, film, TV, music, games, and comics.

posts.name: Sysone
posts.tagline: Typed AI decisions in TypeScript. Zero dependencies.
posts.description: Use Jev for yes/no checks, routing, filtering and ranking in TypeScript. Zero runtime dependencies, 3.9 kB min+gzip with all providers. Try the playground without an account, then copy working code. MIT licensed.

posts.name: SoundLatch
posts.tagline: Stop Windows Switching to the Wrong Audio Device
posts.description: Windows switched your audio device again? SoundLatch lets you put your speakers, headphones, and microphones in priority order, then automatically selects the right device as you connect or disconnect them. No more digging through Windows settings when you unplug your headphones or plug in a new device.

posts.name: ResilAI
posts.tagline: Deterministic incident readiness & ops safety for SMBs
posts.description: ResilAI answers one question every morning: "Can this organization safely operate today?" We collect telemetry from security tools, IAM, and backups to calculate a deterministic Governance Health Index (GHI) mapped to NIST CSF 2.0. LLMs are strictly forbidden from calculating scores; Gemini only translates findings into plain-English business risks and single high-ROI fixes.

posts.name: Chessora
posts.tagline: Can you beat AI in Chess?
posts.description: Chessora makes it simple to play chess against a powerful AI opponent. Choose your difficulty, start a game instantly, and improve your skills through real gameplay. No waiting for an opponent, no complicated setup.

posts.name: EffectDeck
posts.tagline: Effects for any player on your iPhone
posts.description: Android has RootlessJamesDSP — system-wide audio effects without root. iOS had nothing. Not a worse version. Nothing. AUv3 only runs inside a DAW, EQ apps only touch their own player. iOS 27 cracked it open: an app can now present itself as an audio output device. Pick EffectDeck in Control Center and everything you play goes through your chain — Spotify, YouTube, podcasts, anything. 100+ effects from EffeTune's DSP core. IR reverb, analyzers, a 16x16 matrix. Free, no account, no ads.

posts.name: Star Skimmer 3D
posts.tagline: No install — just click and skim through space
posts.description: Star Skimmer 3D is a browser-based endless runner built with Three.js — no download, no install, just click and play. Pick between three ships (Comet, Raptor, Nebula), each with its own feel, and skim through a procedurally escalating obstacle field using boost and shield mechanics that force fast trade-offs. Built solo as a side project to see how far a lightweight WebGL game could go in a single tab.

posts.name: SuperX Code
posts.tagline: AI coding agent that turns ideas into working software.
posts.description: SuperX Code is an AI coding agent that helps you build, modify, debug, and improve software directly in your project. It understands your codebase, edits files, executes development tasks, validates changes, and fixes real issues. Build features, fix bugs, create applications, and work on websites using natural-language instructions.

posts.name: Betterswitch
posts.tagline: A native macOS window switcher built for productivity
posts.description: Betterswitch is a fast macOS window switcher that brings every open window into reach. Switch directly between windows, apps, and workspaces.

posts.name: PDFCraft
posts.tagline: 100% Free & Private Online PDF Converter (Processes Locally)
posts.description: Most online PDF tools upload private files to servers, risking your data. To solve this, I built PDFCraft! ⚡  It's a serverless Next.js web app running 100% client-side. All parsing and conversion happens locally inside your browser—your files NEVER leave your device.  🔒 Features:  * Images to PDF & Merge PDF * PDF to JPG Converter * 100% Free & No Sign-up required! Built for students & remote workers. Love to hear your feedback! 🚀

posts.name: Outpost16
posts.tagline: Keep every product’s growth in sight.
posts.description: Outpost16 is the growth command center for founders running one or more products. Bring activation, traffic, SEO, authority, and publishing signals into one calm view, then see what changed and what deserves attention next. Replace dashboard-hopping and metric guesswork with focused actions and a simple record of what you learn. Built for solo founders and small teams. Start free and keep every product’s growth in sight.

posts.name: Motqn AI - Teachers Destination for AI
posts.tagline: Lesson plans, slides & tests from your curriculum in seconds
posts.description: Motqn is an AI assistant built for teachers. Upload your textbook or curriculum, and it instantly generates curriculum-aligned lesson plans, interactive PowerPoint presentations with images, and ready-to-export tests with adjustable difficulty, then grades and evaluates them automatically. With Tabshoura Plus, you get a voice-based assistant for real-time conversation, shared whiteboard collaboration, and generating presentations and tests as you talk.

posts.name: CelitePro
posts.tagline: Professional Videos. Made Simple.
posts.description: CelitePro introduces a new approach to professional video creation by combining complex multi-layer templates, intelligent content-to-layer mapping, automated workflows, and cloud rendering. Users simply upload their content, while CelitePro maps it to the correct template layers and delivers the final video without requiring high-end hardware or advanced editing skills. It also focuses on regional templates, consistent output, and low-cost video production.

posts.name: MagicSheet
posts.tagline: Blazing fast AI decisions across thousands of rows
posts.description: MagicSheet turns repetitive human judgment into a spreadsheet operation. Upload a CSV, describe what you want AI to decide, and process thousands of rows at once — from search query classification to lead scoring, tagging, and text analysis.

posts.name: Wapas
posts.tagline: Everything finds its way back.
posts.description: Lost your wallet? Found someone's keys? Wapas connects the two of you with verified claims, private contact, and a handover you can prove.

posts.name: ALTA v10.0
posts.tagline: PyQt6 E2E Encrypted Messenger & AI Boilerplate
posts.description: A complete, premium Python source code boilerplate for a desktop messenger ecosystem. Built with PyQt6, it includes a Client app and a Headless Relay Server. Features military-grade client-side E2E encryption (AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2), real-time multi-threaded audio/video/screen streaming, and a secure 3-pass DoD file wiping mechanism. Includes a built-in Llama 3.3 AI assistant via Groq API for document summarization and Pollinations AI image gen.
